name: FusionMap VoxelMorph-diff (PET->MRI)
architecture: 3-D U-Net on a 4 mm grid, enc (16,32,32) / dec (32,32) / final (32,16); stationary velocity at 1/2 resolution (8 mm), 7-step scaling & squaring

input.grid: 4.0 mm canonical grid centred on the head (2 mm sampling, 2x pooled)

intended_use: Research prototype. Trained on simulated brain PET/MRI phantoms only.
note: Early-stopped at 3,000 of 12,000 planned iterations: validation residual error matched rigid-only alignment (1.172 vs 1.173 mm). On brain phantoms the residual non-rigid motion (~1 mm) is below what 6 mm-resolution PET resolves, so FusionMap's auto mode keeps rigid MI; VoxelMorph remains selectable and is the intended engine for deformable body sites.
